title: SimplePractice Session Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: SimplePractice therapy sessions (`simplepractice:session`), Headway appointments (`headway:appointment`), BetterHelp sessions (`betterhelp:session`), CBT homework logs (`cbt:homework`), and Daylio mood entries (`daylio:mood`).
app: SimplePractice session notes, Headway appointment confirmations, BetterHelp messaging sessions, CBT homework trackers, and Daylio mood exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=simplepractice:session
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by therapist_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when SimplePractice therapy session data has stopped arriving for a given therapist.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per therapist and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when one part of your SimplePractice therapy session feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
